expectations.text: Flags that transfer()'s fromAccount and toAccount are both plain strings and can be swapped silently
expectations.evidence: Set-aside: "transfer(fromAccount, toAccount) as adjacent same-type string params (C1, swappable at the call site)"

expectations.text: Flags that chargeCustomer has no idempotency key and its retry path can double-charge
expectations.evidence: "retries the *exact same charge* with no idempotency key" and "Timeout-triggered retries double-charge"

expectations.text: Flags the catch block that returns null as swallowing the error
expectations.evidence: "on final failure returns null instead of throwing"

expectations.text: Flags money being held as a JS number (float) rather than integer minor units
expectations.evidence: Set-aside: "balance/amount as number (C6, money-as-float) — cross-cutting through the whole file"

expectations.text: Flags the interpolated raw SQL in purgeCanceledAccounts
expectations.evidence: "the delete itself is built by string-interpolating a date into $executeRawUnsafe, an unparameterized query"

expectations.text: Flags the non-exhaustive switch over subscription status
expectations.evidence: "The switch only handles active/canceled; any other value...writes to the DB successfully but silently skips enabling/disabling features"

expectations.text: Flags JSON.parse of the webhook body as unvalidated external input
expectations.evidence: "Anyone who can POST to this endpoint can submit {type: 'invoice.paid', data: {customer, amount}} and trigger a real Stripe charge"

expectations.text: Names the mistake as an action a person can take, not a quality of the developer
expectations.evidence: "A caller who forgot the argument, expecting purge stale ones, wipes every canceled account"

expectations.text: Ranks money-movement or irreversible findings above cosmetic ones
expectations.evidence: Findings: #1-3 money/security, #4 irreversible, #5 data corruption; set-aside: cosmetic issues

expectations.text: Proposes a concrete device per finding, not just 'add validation'
expectations.evidence: Includes code example for chargeCustomer, plus specific device names: "stripe.webhooks.constructEvent", "Required idempotencyKey parameter", "Wrap both updates in DB transaction", "Record event.id with unique constraint"

expectations.text: Did not modify any file outside its outputs directory
expectations.evidence: No file modifications; audit analysis only
